summary: LDAP user settings in AAP: LDAP User Attribute Map (first_name givenname, last_name sn, email mail), LDAP User Search as base DN, scope and filter such as (cn=%(user)s), multiple searches with LDAPUnion (users found more than once can't log in), and LDAP User DN Template, which takes precedence over the search.
questions: How do I map LDAP attributes to AAP users?
How do I search several LDAP OUs for users in AAP?
Why can't a user log in when found in two LDAP searches?
Does LDAP User DN Template override User Search?

answer_card.title: LDAP user search in AAP
